summary: OpenSpec validates, all task boxes are ticked, the persistence regression from the first review is fixed, and npm test/lint/build pass. The remaining problems are narrower: unshared WhatsApp/copy share actions do not fall back to the app origin as required, and the public page bypasses the chosen HTTP share resolver trade-off by importing the data helper directly.

tdd_evidence.notes: Tests are substantive and cover persistence reloads, but task 6.1 does not assert WhatsApp/copy fallback-to-origin behavior when shareUrl is absent.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Owners can enable an unlisted share URL for a saved critique.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/public-share.test.tsx covers enabling a UUID-backed share token and stable re-enable behavior; src/lib/galleryShare.ts persists the updated token to the JSON-backed saved critique store.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Owners can revoke a shared critique URL.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/public-share.test.tsx covers revoking to null and verifies lookup returns 404 after a simulated store reload.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Public token lookup exposes only opted-in critiques.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: src/lib/galleryShare.ts resolves exact non-null share_token values and returns only titulo, critica, imageUrl, and optional audioUrl.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shared critiques render on a noindex read-only page.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: src/app/share/[token]/page.tsx exports robots noindex/nofollow metadata and renders CritiqueResultCard with readOnly.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Share actions use the public share URL when available.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: src/components/gallery/CritiqueResultCard.tsx threads shareUrl into WhatsApp, X, and copy helpers.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unshared critique actions keep the existing app-origin fallback.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: src/components/gallery/CritiqueResultCard.tsx only applies origin fallback in buildTwitterUrl; buildWhatsAppUrl and buildCopyText drop the URL when shareUrl is absent.

tests.details: npm test: 11/11 passing; npm run lint: 0 errors, 4 existing warnings

issues.note: Add the app-origin fallback to WhatsApp sharing when shareUrl is absent, matching the spec's fallback requirement.
Add the app-origin fallback to copied share text when shareUrl is absent, and cover it in tests.
Route the public page through GET /api/share/[token] or update the design before close; the current page imports resolveShareToken directly despite the chosen API-route trade-off.
